# Rocking Furniture

> > Rocking Furniture specializes in handcrafted outdoor furniture including Amish-made porch swings, recycled plastic patio furniture, and cedar garden benches from premium American manufacturers.

The site features outdoor furniture from leading brands including A&L Furniture Co. (Regallion Outdoor), LuxCraft, Bryton Park Poly Furniture, and Wildridge. Products emphasize sustainable materials like recycled HDPE plastic and Western Red Cedar, with many pieces handcrafted by Amish artisans in the USA.

## Key Topics

- Recycled HDPE plastic furniture
- Amish handcrafted furniture
- Western Red Cedar products
- A&L Furniture Co. / Regallion Outdoor
- LuxCraft outdoor furniture
- Bryton Park Poly Furniture
- Porch swings and gliders
- Garden benches
- Outdoor dining sets
- Yellow pine furniture
- Natural-Kote finish
- Made in USA
- California Proposition 65 compliance
- Sunbrella outdoor cushions
- Sustainable outdoor furniture
